summaries.Romania: Romania faces fiscal pressures with a revised deficit of 150B lei (22B higher than committed) and political turbulence over administrative reforms and media freedom. Energy security remains precarious as hydroelectric reserves fall short of winter demand.

items.title: Apple's Claris Testing 'Harbor' App for Local AI on Macs
items.snippet:
Apple's Claris subsidiary is testing an app called Harbor, which turns Apple silicon Macs into a private AI server.





Harbor works with a single Apple silicon Mac, but it also supports connecting multiple Mac computers over Thunderbolt 5 to pool unified memory for larger models. Apple added RDMA
items.line: Apple's Harbor app enables local AI model execution on Mac silicon, allowing private inference across single or networked machines via Thunderbolt 5.

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic face new oversight as New York’s AI safety law takes effect
items.snippet: New York is preparing to enforce its sweeping AI safety law, requiring major developers like OpenAI and Anthropic to register, disclose safety practices, and report critical incidents or face fines.
items.line: New York's AI safety law takes effect, requiring major developers to register and report critical incidents, establishing first-mover regulatory precedent.
